title: Final Charge Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the bound charge density as rho = -P_0.

title: Final Magnetic Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must conclude that the magnetic field B = 0 at points on the axis of the cylinder.

title: Divergence Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct application of the divergence operator to find the charge density.

title: Current Density Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the volume current density correctly using the given polarization and angular velocity.

title: Surface Charge Density
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include the calculation of the surface charge density sigma = P_0 a / 2.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly evaluate the volume and surface integrals contributing to the magnetic field.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the calculations of current and magnetic field.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
